game_concept: A arcade set in Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate, a weathered stone gate: the ruin warden must handle eldritch shades while practicing lists. Core idea – Merge Convoy: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Weathered Gate: a weathered stone gate
core_gameplay_loop: In Weathered Gate, repeat each round: Merge two lists using + or extend() to join convoys. Each round, a new rune stones challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the convoy_size value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of rune stones by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 6 (applied tier): Merge Convoy
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Merge Convoy' (Week 7 slot 13), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Weathered Gate'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how convoy_size changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against eldritch shades in Weathered Gate.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
